# basalt-ui v2.20.0
# Opinionated framework for Mantine-based React apps — theme, app shell, TanStack Charts, toolchain presets
#
# Entry points: use the exact import specifier below; do not guess.
# basalt-ui            BasaltProvider, createBasaltRouter, BasaltShell, defineNav, PageBar, Section
# basalt-ui/tokens     VX, defineSeries, groupTokens, buildPaletteCss
# basalt-ui/charts     CartesianChart, Lines, Bars, ChartCard
# basalt-ui/controls   FilterSet, ViewTabs, RangeFilter, SelectFilter
# basalt-ui/state      createSearchStore, createPersistedState
# basalt-ui/vite       basaltViteConfig, basaltAppPlugin
# Required peers (install for `.`): react, react-dom, @mantine/{core,hooks,modals,notifications,spotlight},
# @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/react-query and the three @fontsource-variable faces.
# A subpath's `Install:` line is its required peers; `OptionalPeers:` are import()-only, install on use.

Package: basalt-ui
Version: 2.20.0

## basalt-ui
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui'
Description: Wiring (`BasaltProvider`, `createBasaltTheme`, `createBasaltRouter`, `unwrap`), shell + nav (`BasaltShell`, `PageBar`, `PageAside`, `PageTitle`, `ThemeToggle`, `defineNav`/`navGroup`/`navTarget`/`flattenNav`, `useBasaltNav`, `useSizeClass`, `useCoarsePointer`), dashboard (`Section`, `WidgetHeader`, `StatCard`, `StatGroup`, `DeltaBadge`, `EmptyState`, `SettingsSection`/`SettingsRow`/`DangerZone`). Reaches no subpath-required peer.
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-mantine

## basalt-ui/content
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/content'
Description: Prose (article/chat typography), Callout, TableOfContents (given a containerRef it collects the id-bearing h2/h3 under that one container — levels changes which — on mount and on every DOM childList change, so it reads the slug ids `Markdown` gives every heading; `Prose` sets no ids and an explicit items list replaces collection), Markdown (react-markdown + remark-gfm, optional peers; `streaming` is a rendering mode ONLY — `contentTrust` is the independent security input, and any surface rendering agent/model output must pin `contentTrust="untrusted"`, the sole input to the image-origin allowlist; `fenceRenderers` extends fenced-block rendering — settledOnly/FenceRenderer/FenceRenderers; `sanitizeSchema` is an additions-only SanitizeSchemaExtension merged over the default via mergeSanitizeSchema; shiki code blocks, beautiful-mermaid diagrams and the remend streaming repair load lazily from optional peers), ArticleLayout (docs-page frame), GuideLink (contextual-help link) — the content/prose surface

## basalt-ui/controls
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/controls'
Description: The control tier (docs/CONTROLS-SPEC.md §3). Exports: `FilterSet` (nowrap row + measured +N fold + the mobile Filters (n) sheet), `RangeFilter`/`SelectFilter`/`MultiSelectFilter`/`NumberFilter`/`SearchFilter`/`ToggleFilter` (each bound to a FieldHandle — no value/onChange/size, law C2/C5; `NumberFilter` is the field.number lane, a radio list over `options` or a stepper without), `ViewTabs`, `SyncButton` with the `BarAction`/`GlobalAction` types, and the form layout `FormRow`/`FormGroup` (moved here from ./forms in 1.36.0 — `FormRow` is law C1’s form row and needs no @mantine/form). THREE surfaces, picked by the home and never by a prop: pill in a PageBar row, sheet in the mobile Filters (n) drawer, panel in a PageAside body — where every control renders an inspector/facet ROW instead of a chip (docs/ASIDE-SPEC.md §3); the counts/max props on `MultiSelectFilter` render the Foundry facet list there. Every control owns its own desktop/mobile swap in CSS (C9) and renders size="ctl" internally. Resolves and renders with NO @mantine/dates installed — the custom date picker is injected through RangeFilter.customPicker from ./controls-dates.
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-controls

## basalt-ui/controls-dates
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/controls-dates'
Description: DateRangePicker — the @mantine/dates implementation of RangeFilter's customPicker seam. Its own subpath because @mantine/dates is an optional peer and basaltViteConfig pre-bundles the whole @mantine scope, so a consumer without the peer (linewatch) must never resolve it: nothing under src/controls may import it, statically or lazily (docs/CONTROLS-SPEC.md §3).
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-controls
Signature: DateRangePicker(props: RangeCustomPickerProps): ReactNode
  value: { readonly from?: string | undefined; readonly to?: string …
  onChange: (next: { from: string; to: string; }) => void
Install: bun add @mantine/dates@^9.7.0 dayjs@^1.11.0
